title: Year 1 - Foundations to independent playing
description: The complete 52-week first-year route from the curated master guitar course. Weekly BPM values are starting reference points, not deadlines or mandatory pass marks. Use the checkpoint to decide when to advance.

phases.title: Beginner base
phases.goal: Setup, clean notes, reading basics, open chords, pulse and first review.

phases.title: Skills in context
phases.goal: Picking, fingerstyle, scales, shell chords, blues, expressive technique and the mid-year test.

phases.title: Early intermediate
phases.goal: Fretboard navigation, triads, harmony, rhythm subdivisions, legato and review.

phases.title: Intermediate bridge
phases.goal: Ear learning, creative work, genre vocabulary, reading, performance and year-end assessment.

weeks.title: Meet your guitar
weeks.focus: Setup, posture, string names and tuning
weeks.checkpoint: Tune all six strings; name them low-to-high E-A-D-G-B-E.
weeks.practiceExercise: Open-string pulse: four relaxed quarter notes per string; listen, hum the string names and tap a steady beat

weeks.title: Clear single notes
weeks.focus: Fretting-hand basics, clean tone and relaxed pressure
weeks.checkpoint: Fret one note close behind the fret and coordinate both hands.

weeks.title: Read guitar maps
weeks.focus: Chord-box orientation, TAB lines and fret numbers
weeks.checkpoint: Translate a short TAB line into string and fret movements.

weeks.title: First chord shapes
focus: Form Em, pick strings 6 through 1 separately and correct one unclear note.
Form G and repeat the same six-string check.
Alternate Em and G after four counted beats; keep the strumming hand moving during the change.
weeks.checkpoint: Form Em (022000) and G (320003), sound each intended string clearly, then change between the shapes while keeping a steady four-beat pulse.
weeks.practiceExercise: Em-G pulse: one chord per bar

weeks.title: Open chords A, D and E
weeks.focus: Three essential open-chord shapes
weeks.checkpoint: Form A, D and E and check every intended string.

weeks.title: First complete chord loop
weeks.focus: Chord changes with pulse and a first musical phrase
weeks.checkpoint: Play a four-chord loop with four beats per chord.
weeks.practiceExercise: Em-G-D-A loop, one bar each; change on the beat at a comfortable tempo

weeks.title: Strum in time
focus: Play eight evenly spaced down-up strokes on muted strings while saying the count.
Repeat and skip the string contact on the selected '&' while keeping the hand's motion.
Add one chord and preserve the same timing; lower the tempo if the subdivision becomes uneven.
weeks.checkpoint: Count eighth notes evenly, play a down-up pattern on muted strings, and keep the hand moving through one deliberately skipped stroke.

weeks.title: Optional notation: strings 1 and 2
weeks.focus: Parallel track: first-position notes on high E and B
weeks.checkpoint: Core: play the melody from TAB. Optional: match the same notes to staff notation.
weeks.practiceExercise: High E-B answer phrase (TAB first; staff-reading optional)

weeks.title: Add C, Am and Dm
weeks.focus: Major/minor open chords and smooth transitions
weeks.checkpoint: Learn C, Am and Dm; move between them at a slow pulse.

weeks.title: Make rhythm musical
weeks.focus: Accents, rests and dynamics
weeks.checkpoint: Play a pattern with one accent and one intentional rest.
weeks.practiceExercise: Accent beats 2 and 4; rest on beat 3

weeks.title: Your first music map
focus: Find E, F, G and A on the low E string and say the fret number for each.
Find A, B, C and D on the A string and say the fret number for each.
Choose a note name and locate it on both strings, explaining the fret movement used.
weeks.checkpoint: Name the open strings E–A–D–G–B–E, explain that adjacent frets are one semitone apart, and locate two requested natural notes on the low E and A strings.

weeks.title: Quarter 1 review and recording
weeks.focus: Consolidate tuning, reading, open chords and pulse
weeks.checkpoint: Review Weeks 1-11: tune, keep a pulse, play open chords and a short melody; record a clean 45-second excerpt

weeks.title: Optional notation: strings 3 and 4
weeks.focus: Parallel track: extend staff-reading to G and D strings
weeks.checkpoint: Core: play the TAB phrase. Optional: identify matching G- and D-string notes.
weeks.practiceExercise: G-D string answer melody (TAB core; staff optional)

weeks.title: Optional notation: low E and A landmarks
weeks.focus: Parallel track: low-string fretboard landmarks
weeks.checkpoint: Core: find listed frets and play TAB. Optional: connect note names to staff positions.
weeks.practiceExercise: Low-string landmark walk (TAB first; notation optional)

weeks.title: Pick control and clean tone
focus: Play a four-note D–U–D–U cell on one string.
Repeat on two strings, planning the crossing before the first note on the new string.
Record or listen to one pass and identify whether timing, volume or pick depth changed at the crossing.
weeks.checkpoint: Play a down-up-down-up sequence on one string, then carry the alternating sequence across two neighbouring strings without losing an even attack.

weeks.title: Fingerstyle foundation
focus: Loop the thumb part alone until the bass spacing is steady.
Add one treble note at a time while the thumb continues its pulse.
Change the treble-note order and keep the bass role unchanged.
weeks.checkpoint: Keep a steady bass-thumb pulse while adding a four-note treble pattern without interrupting the bass role.

weeks.title: Build the major scale
focus: Play one octave of C major and name each note while playing.
Say the A minor pentatonic notes A–C–D–E–G and locate the root A.
Create a short phrase using only those five notes and finish on A.
weeks.checkpoint: Play and name a one-octave C major fragment, then identify A–C–D–E–G as A minor pentatonic and resolve a short phrase to A.

weeks.title: Shell chords: roots and guide tones
weeks.focus: Three-note chord grips as a bridge to movable chords
weeks.checkpoint: Play Cmaj7, Dm7 and G7 shell grips; move Dm7-G7-Cmaj7 in time.
weeks.practiceExercise: Three-note shell progression: Dm7-G7-Cmaj7, one bar each

weeks.title: Your first 12-bar blues
weeks.focus: Blues form, dominant seventh colour and groove
weeks.checkpoint: Play a 12-bar blues in A with a steady quarter-note pulse.

weeks.title: Play with expression
weeks.focus: Slides, bends, dynamics and phrasing
weeks.checkpoint: Use one expressive technique accurately in a short phrase.

weeks.title: Movable power chords
weeks.focus: Root-5 shapes, muting and rock rhythm
weeks.checkpoint: Move a power-chord shape and mute unwanted strings.

weeks.title: Approach barre chords safely
weeks.focus: Partial barre shape and efficient pressure
weeks.checkpoint: Build a partial F shape and test each string individually.

weeks.title: Minor pentatonic box 1
focus: Play the box 1 shape slowly from low E to high E and back.
Name the A root when it appears on the low E and high E strings.
Create a short phrase using the five notes and end on A.
weeks.checkpoint: Play A minor pentatonic box 1 across the six strings, identify the root A locations and end a short phrase on A.

weeks.title: Half-year playing test
weeks.focus: Integrate chords, rhythm, melody and recording
weeks.checkpoint: Perform one chord piece, one melody and one lead phrase.

weeks.title: Find roots and octaves
weeks.focus: Fretboard navigation beyond open position
weeks.checkpoint: Find the same root in two positions and play an octave jump.

weeks.title: Triads on the top strings
focus: Play each C, F and G triad reference one string at a time.
Name the root, third and fifth before sounding the triad together.
Move from one triad to the next and keep the intended three-note voicing clear.
weeks.checkpoint: Play C, F and G triads on the top three strings, name each root and identify the three chord tones in the selected voicing.

weeks.title: Chords in keys
weeks.focus: Roman numerals and diatonic chord families
weeks.checkpoint: Build I, IV, V and vi in C and G major.

weeks.title: Capo and transposition
weeks.focus: Move a song to a comfortable singing key
weeks.checkpoint: Use a capo or transpose a short progression and explain the result.

weeks.title: Suspended and seventh chords
weeks.focus: Add colour tones without losing pulse
weeks.checkpoint: Compare D-Dsus4-D and A-A7-A.

weeks.title: Sixteenth-note rhythm
weeks.focus: Count subdivisions and control accents
weeks.checkpoint: Count 1-e-and-a at a slow tempo and play a clean muted pattern.

weeks.title: Hammer-ons and pull-offs
weeks.focus: Legato notes with consistent volume
weeks.checkpoint: Play a hammer-on and pull-off without re-picking every note.

weeks.title: Quarter 2 review
weeks.focus: Revisit notes, chords, fingerstyle, scales and blues
weeks.checkpoint: Select two weak skills from Weeks 13-31 and retest them.
weeks.practiceExercise: Review medley at a comfortable tempo

weeks.title: Major pentatonic and phrasing
weeks.focus: Contrast major and minor pentatonic colour
weeks.checkpoint: Play a short major pentatonic phrase over a major chord.

weeks.title: Improvise with motifs
weeks.focus: Repeat, vary and resolve short melodic ideas
weeks.checkpoint: Create a four-bar solo from a two-note motif.

weeks.title: Arpeggios and chord tones
weeks.focus: Outline harmony with notes of each chord
weeks.checkpoint: Play an arpeggio that follows Em-G-D-C without losing the beat.

weeks.title: Three notes per string
weeks.focus: Extend the scale beyond first position
weeks.checkpoint: Play a short three-notes-per-string fragment with alternate picking.

weeks.title: Learn a melody by ear
focus: Hum the phrase and repeat it in short fragments of two or three notes.
Clap the rhythm separately from the pitch task.
Locate the opening note, work out subsequent interval movement and record note order.
Replay the source only after the first independent transcription, then correct one specific difference.
weeks.checkpoint: Transcribe a two-bar melody from sound without first reading TAB, preserving its note order and rhythm and describing one interval movement.

weeks.title: Songwriting and arrangement
weeks.focus: Create an original 4- or 8-bar section
weeks.checkpoint: Write a progression and pair it with a melody or picking pattern.

weeks.title: Blues turnarounds
weeks.focus: End a blues chorus and lead into the next cycle
weeks.checkpoint: Play a short turnaround and return to the I chord on time.

weeks.title: Rock rhythm and muting
weeks.focus: Palm muting, power-chord changes and silence
weeks.checkpoint: Play two power chords with tight starts and stops.

weeks.title: Jazz chord grips
weeks.focus: Basic maj7, m7 and dominant 7 colour
weeks.checkpoint: Play Dm7-G7-Cmaj7 as a slow ii-V-I.

weeks.title: The ii-V-I connection
weeks.focus: Connect jazz chords with voice leading
weeks.checkpoint: Move Dm7-G7-Cmaj7 using the smallest hand movement.

weeks.title: Comping styles
weeks.focus: Change the accompaniment rhythm without changing harmony
weeks.checkpoint: Play the same progression as straight eighths, shuffle and sparse accents.

weeks.title: Quarter 3 review
weeks.focus: Retest barre, triads, ear skills, 16ths and lead phrasing
weeks.checkpoint: Choose a chord task, rhythm task and melody task from Weeks 25-43.

weeks.title: Sight-read across strings
weeks.focus: Read pitch and rhythm together
weeks.checkpoint: Read a short melody on strings 1-4 with rests and repeated notes.

weeks.title: Move between positions
weeks.focus: Connect two scale areas using a guide tone
weeks.checkpoint: Link two positions of G major and land on B or G.

weeks.title: Chord melody basics
weeks.focus: Place melody notes above simple chord tones
weeks.checkpoint: Harmonise a three-note melody using small chord shapes.

weeks.title: Compose a complete study
weeks.focus: Write an 8-bar piece with clear form
weeks.checkpoint: Build an A section and contrasting B section from your motifs.

weeks.title: Dynamics and articulation
weeks.focus: Control volume, note length and phrase endings
weeks.checkpoint: Perform the same phrase softly, loudly and with a clear final note.

weeks.title: Repertoire polishing
weeks.focus: Bring one complete piece close to performance-ready
weeks.checkpoint: Choose a piece with a beginning, middle and ending and polish transitions.
weeks.practiceExercise: Personal repertoire piece: weakest transition loop

weeks.title: Mock performance and transcription
weeks.focus: Perform, listen back and reproduce one short phrase
weeks.checkpoint: Record a complete take and transcribe a short phrase by ear.

weeks.title: Year-end playing test
weeks.focus: Demonstrate rhythm, chords, reading, lead/fingerstyle and musicianship
weeks.checkpoint: Perform a prepared piece, a sight-read excerpt and a short improvised phrase.

revisionNotes: 1.1.0: Added the GuitarLab spiral learning framework; preserved all existing week IDs and sequence except prerequisite correction in Week 6 and a narrower first fretboard checkpoint in Week 11.
